_source: GPU-R Matching Engine Spec v1 + REVIEW_LOG decisions; records = frozen files of 24.10.2026

route_groups._rule: same base id; evaluate every member, show ONE result = best list, then fewest gaps; name the route used

separate_variants._rule: different content; show each as its own programme

gated_routes._rule: offer the route only when the student profile carries the confirmation; otherwise skip it and show what is needed

4594_B.why: Route B has no grade limit; GATE >= 500 replaces the 85 % CGPA (SPSO § 2 Abs. 2 Nr. 2)

4124_B.why: 20 LP route needs a water-related bachelor thesis (ZO § 2(1))

5351_B.why: grade band plus a module average the engine cannot compute

5351_D.why: grade band plus a module average the engine cannot compute

4092_B.why: needs at least 10 subject/thesis points the engine cannot read

exclusions._rule: checked first; a hit = list 4 with this reason

4352.reason: Regulation: Indian bachelor degrees not equivalent / extra conditions (R16)

4202.reason: Regulation: Indian bachelor degrees not equivalent / extra conditions (R16)

10623.reason: Shown only to Electrical / Electrical and Electronics Engineering degree holders (Koushik 20.10.2026; PO § 7 Abs. 1)

area_caps._rule: v1 engine config (v2: record field conditional_admission.area_caps, pending Koushik). 'items' = indices into subject_credit_requirements.items, with the label start for a safety check. A real gap above any cap = not eligible.

areas.name: engineering + civil + subject-specific fundamentals (PO § 3(3)b; mechanics/hydromechanics belong to the maths-physics block, capped only by the total)

always_display.text: APS certificate required for applicants from India (Koushik 24.10.2026)

presence_gap_with_conditions.gap_text: one module, size decided by the university

max_unmet_presence_items._rule: Tolerance rules: at most N of the listed presence-only items may be unmet; no conditions/bridging. N or fewer unmet = eligible (listed as an unmet area in the report); more = not eligible. 'items' = indices into subject_credit_requirements.items, with label starts as a safety check.

separate_subjects._rule: Koushik 27.10.2026: where the regulation names Mathematik and Statistik side by side (not 'of which'), a statistics course counts under Statistik only, never under Mathematik. Item index -> categories removed from that item's target set. 8911 ('Mathematik 20, of which Statistik 5') is nested and NOT listed.

6318.why: PO § 3(2)b: Mathematik 16 + Statistik 3 + Mechanik 16 + Hydromechanik 6 = 41 (separate parts)

4881.why: PO § 3: Mathematik und Statistik 18 (at least 14 maths, at least 2 statistics)

committee_check._rule: Koushik rule 30.10.2026: the regulation says a committee decides comparability -> eligible WITH a following step (list 2, never list 1). Only records whose regulation says so (read 30.10.2026).
